name: TAF Demographic and Eligibility (DE) Base File
description: The TAF Demographic and Eligibility (DE) Base File contains annual, beneficiary-level demographic and enrollment summary information for individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP at any point during the year. One record per beneficiary per state per year.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Demographic and Eligibility Denominator File
description: Annual beneficiary-level file containing demographic characteristics and summary enrollment information for all individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP during the year. Derived from the CMS T-MSIS Analytic Files (TAF) Demographic and Eligibility (DE) segment.

content.birth_dt: Date32[day]: Date of Birth. Beneficiary's date of birth; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years
content.death_dt: Date32[day]: Date of Death. Beneficiary's date of death, if applicable. If the beneficiary is deceased, then this variable is populated with the death date, which may be in the calendar year of the data file or the two prior years.
content.sex_cd: String: Sex (Biological) - Latest in Year. The beneficiary's biological sex; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.ethncty_cd: String: Ethnicity Code - Latest in Year. A code indicating that the beneficiary's ethnicity is Hispanic, Latino/a, or Spanish; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.race_ethncty_cd: String: Race and Ethnicity Constructed Code - Latest in Year. A constructed variable indicating the beneficiary's race and ethnicity; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.race_ethncty_exp_cd: String: Expanded Race and Ethnicity Constructed Code - Latest in Year. A constructed variable that is an expanded code indicating the beneficiary's race and ethnicity; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.crftd_amrcn_indn_alskn_ntv_cd: String: Certified American Indian or Alaska Native Code - Latest in Year. "American Indian or Alaska Native" means any beneficiary defined at 25 USC 1603(13), 1603(28), or 1679(a), or who has been determined eligible as an Indian, pursuant to 42 CFR Sec. 136.12; i.e., a Certificate of Degree of Indian or Alaska Native Blood (CDIB). Please refer to the COMMENT for a complete definition of CBID.
content.bene_id: String: Encrypted CCW Beneficiary Identifier. Encrypted CCW Beneficiary Identifier The Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW) assigns a unique beneficiary identification number to each individual who receives Medicare and/or Medicaid, and uses that number to identify an individual's records in all CCW data files (e.g., Medicare claims, Medicare encounter, MAX claims, T-MSIS claims, and MDS assessment data). This number does not change during a beneficiary's lifetime and each number is used only once. The BENE_ID is specific to the CCW and is not applicable to any other identification system or data source.
content.filename: String: FILENAME. Filename of the source file or record provenance field. Not found in the TAF DE codebook; likely added during parquet export or ETL.
content.msis_id: String: Encrypted State Assigned Beneficiary Unique Identifier. A state-assigned unique identification number used to identify a Medicaid/CHIP enrolled beneficiary and any claims submitted to the system. Also referred to as the Medicaid Statistical Information System Identifier (MSIS_ID).
content.year: Int32: Reference Year. Reference year of the data file. Your parquet field appears to be a renamed version of RFRNC_YR.
content.state_cd: String: Submitting State Alpha Abbreviation. Submitting State (postal abbreviation)
content.submitting_state: String: Submitting State Entity Code. The ANSI Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) numeric state code for the U.S. state, territory, or the District of Columbia that has submitted the data.
content.bene_state_cd: String: State FIPS Code for Beneficiary Home or Mailing Address - Latest in Year. The ANSI state numeric for the U.S. state, territory, or the District of Columbia code for where the beneficiary eligible to receive healthcare services resides; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.misg_elgblty_data_ind: Int32: Indicator of Missing Eligibility Record for All Months of Service Year. A flag to indicate that the person had claims for the year but no eligibility information.
content.misg_enrlmt_type_ind: Int32: Missing Enrollment Type Code in Monthly Beneficiary Summary File - January-December (01-12). A flag indicating the person had only unknown enrollment in the month. Your parquet field appears to collapse the 12 monthly MISG_ENRLMT_TYPE_IND_01-12 variables into a list.
content.bene_zip_cd: String: ZIP Code for Beneficiary Home or Mailing Address - Latest in Year. The zip code for the beneficiary home address; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.bene_cnty_cd: String: County Code for Beneficiary Home or Mailing Address - Latest in Year. ANSI county numeric FIPS code indicating the county for the selected type of address
content.age_grp_cd: Int32: Age Group. A beneficiary's age group (in years) during the last month of enrollment in the calendar year, grouped into categories.
content.death_ind: Int32: Indicator that Beneficiary Died During the Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary was deceased in the calendar year of the data file, or in a prior year.
content.mdcd_enrlmt_days_yr: Int32: Medicaid Enrollment Days - Total in Year. Number of days of Medicaid enrollment in the calendar year, including traditional Medicaid and Medicaid Expansion Children's Health Insurance Program (M-CHIP) enrolled days.
content.chip_enrlmt_days_yr: Int32: CHIP Enrollment Days - Total in Year. Number of days of CHIP enrollment in the calendar year.
content.chip_cd_ltst: String: Medicaid, Medicaid Expansion CHIP, or Separate CHIP Code - Latest in Year. A code used to distinguish among Medicaid, Medicaid Expansion, and Separate CHIP populations; most recent in the calendar year.
content.rstrctd_bnfts_cd_ltst: String: Scope of Medicaid or CHIP Benefits - Latest in Year. A flag that indicates the scope of Medicaid or Children's Health Insurance Program (CHIP) benefits to which a beneficiary is entitled; most recent in the calendar year.
content.dual_elgbl_cd_ltst: String: Medicare-Medicaid Dual Eligibility Code - Latest in Year. Indicates coverage for beneficiaries entitled to Medicare (Part A and/or B benefits) and eligible for some category of Medicaid benefits; most recent in the calendar year.
content.elgblty_grp_cd_ltst: String: Eligibility Group Code - Latest in Year. The eligibility group applicable to the beneficiary based on the eligibility determination process for the calendar year; most recent in the calendar year.
content.masboe_cd_ltst: String: Maintenance Assistance Status and Basis of Eligibility Code - Latest in Year. A beneficiary's Maintenance Assistance Status and Basis of Eligibility (MASBOE) group. This is a three- character designation, where the first character indicates the beneficiary's Maintenance Assistance Status (MAS), e.g., "medically needy", and the second and third positions indicate their Basis of Eligibility (BOE), e.g., "aged"; most recent in the calendar year
content.state_spec_elgblty_grp_cd_ltst: String: State-Specific Eligibility Group Code - Latest in Year. The composite of eligibility mapping factors used to create the corresponding Maintenance Assistance Status (MAS) and Basis of Eligibility (BOE) values (before January 1, 2014) and ELIGIBILITY-GROUP values (on or after January 1, 2014); most recent in the calendar year. This field should not include information that already appears elsewhere on the Eligible-File record even if it is part of the MAS and BOE or ELIGIBILITY-GROUP algorithm (e.g., age information computed from DATE-OF-BIRTH or COUNTY-CODE).
content.mrtl_stus_cd: String: Marital Status Code - Latest in Year. A code to classify eligible beneficiary's marital/domestic-relationship status; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.hsehld_size_cd: String: Household Size Used To Determine Medicaid or CHIP Eligibility - Latest in Year. Household size used in the Medicaid or CHIP eligibility determination process; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.incm_cd: String: Income Relative to the Federal Poverty Level - Latest in Year. A code indicating the federal poverty level range in which the family income falls; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.vet_ind: Int32: Veteran Indicator - Latest in Year. A flag indicating if the beneficiary is a non-citizen who is exempt from the five-year bar on benefits because they are a veteran or an active member of the military, naval, or air service; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.prmry_lang_grp_cd: String: Constructed Primary Language Group Code - Latest in Year. Primary language grouped into categories; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.prmry_lang_cd: String: Primary Language Code - Latest in Year. A code indicating the individual's preferred spoken or written language; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.englsh_lang_prfcncy_cd: String: English Language Proficiency Code - Latest in Year. A code indicating the level of spoken English proficiency by the beneficiary; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.ctznshp_ind: Int32: U.S. Citizenship Indicator - Latest in Year. Indicates if the beneficiary is identified as a U.S. Citizen; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.ctznshp_vrfctn_pendg_ind: Int32: Beneficiary is Enrolled Pending Citizenship Verification - Latest in Year. Indicates the beneficiary is enrolled in Medicaid pending citizenship verification; most recent in the calendar year.
content.imgrtn_stus_cd: String: Immigration Status Code - Latest in Year. The immigration status of the beneficiary; most recent in the calendar year.
content.imgrtn_vrfctn_pendg_ind: Int32: Beneficiary is Enrolled Pending Immigration Verification - Latest in Year. Indicates the beneficiary is enrolled in Medicaid pending immigration verification; most recent in the calendar year.
content.imgrtn_stus_5yr_bar_end_dt: Date32[day]: Immigration Status Five Year Bar End Date - Latest in Year. The date the five-year bar for a beneficiary ends; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years.
content.care_lvl_stus_cd: String: Level of Care Status Code for LTSS - Latest in Year. The level of care required to meet a beneficiary's needs and to determine LTSS program eligibility; most recent in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_deaf_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Deaf - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary is deaf or has serious difficulty hearing; ever in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_blnd_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Blind - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary is blind or has serious difficulty seeing, even when wearing glasses; ever in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_dfclty_cncntrtng_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Difficulty Concentrating - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary is five years old or older and has serious difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions because of a physical, mental, or emotional condition; ever in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_dfclty_wlkg_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Difficulty Walking - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary is five years old or older and has serious difficulty walking or climbing stairs; ever in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_dfclty_drsng_bathng_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Difficulty Dressing or Bathing - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary is five years old or older and has difficulty dressing or bathing; ever in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_dfclty_ernds_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Difficulty Running Errands Alone - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary is 15 years old or older and has difficulty doing errands alone such as visiting a doctor's office or shopping because of a physical, mental, or emotional condition; ever in the calendar year.
content.dsblty_othr_ind: Int32: Disability Indicator - Other Disability Not Listed - Ever in Calendar Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary has another disability that is not included here; ever in the calendar year.
content.birth_cncptn_ind: Int32: Birth to Conception Indicator - Latest in Year. A flag to identify children eligible through the conception to birth option, which is available only through a separate CHIP Program; most recent in the calendar year.
content.ssdi_ind: Int32: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) Indicator - Latest in Year. A flag indicating if the beneficiary is enrolled in Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) administered via the Social Security Administration (SSA); most recent in the calendar year.
content.ssi_ind: Int32: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Indicator - Latest in Year. A flag indicating if the beneficiary receives Supplemental Security Income (SSI) administered via the Social Security Administration (SSA); most recent in the calendar year.
content.ssi_stus_cd: String: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) Status Code - Latest in Year. Indicates the beneficiary's SSI status; most recent in the calendar year.
content.ssi_state_splmt_cd: String: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) State Supplement Code - Latest in Year. Indicates the beneficiary's SSI State Supplemental status; most recent in the calendar year.
content.tanf_cash_cd: String: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) Cash Code - Latest in Year. A flag that indicates whether the beneficiary received Federal Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) benefits; most recent in the calendar year.
content.tpl_insrnc_cvrg_ind: Int32: Third-Party Liability (TPL) Insurance Coverage Indicator - Latest in Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary has some form of third-party liability (TPL) insurance coverage; most recent in the calendar year.
content.tpl_othr_cvrg_ind: Int32: Third-Party Liability (TPL) - Other Coverage Indicator - Latest in Year. A flag to indicate whether the beneficiary has some form of third-party liability (TPL) funding besides insurance coverage; most recent in the calendar year.
content.msis_case_num: String: Encrypted TMSIS Case Number - Latest in Year. The state-assigned number which uniquely identifies the Medicaid case to which the enrollee belongs; most recent in the calendar and the two prior years. The definition of a case varies. There are single-person cases (mostly aged and blind/disabled) and multi-person cases (mostly TANF) in which all members of the case have the same case number, but a unique MSIS identification number. A warning for longitudinal research efforts: a person's case number may change over time.
content.splmtl_dts: String: Beneficiary Record in Supplemental Dates File. A flag to indicate that there is record in the Eligibility Dates supplemental file for this person.
content.splmtl_mc: String: Beneficiary Record in Supplemental Managed Care File. A flag to indicate that there is record in the Managed Care (MC) Enrollment supplemental file for this person that includes Managed Care enrollment data.
content.splmtl_wvr: String: Beneficiary Record in Supplemental Waiver File. A flag to indicate that there is record in the Waiver supplemental file for this person.
content.splmtl_hlth_home_spo: String: Beneficiary Record in Supplemental Health Home and State Plan Option (SPO) File. A flag to indicate that there is a record in the health home (HLTH_HOME) state plan option (SPO) supplemental file for this person that includes health home or Community First, 1915i, 1915J, 1915a, 1932a or 1937 SPO participation.
content.splmtl_mfp: String: Beneficiary Record in Supplemental Money Follows Person (MFP) File. A flag to indicate that there is a record in the Money Follows the Person (MFP) supplemental file for this person that includes MFP data.
content.splmtl_dsb_hcbs: String: Beneficiary HCBS Record in Supplemental Disability File. A flag to indicate that there is a record in the disability and need supplemental file for this person that indicates one or more home- and community-based services (HCBS) conditions.
content.splmtl_dsb_ltss: String: Beneficiary LTSS Record in Supplemental Disability File. A flag to indicate that there is record in the disability and need supplemental file for this person that includes Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) data.
content.splmtl_dsb_lckin: String: Beneficiary Lock-In Record in Supplemental Disability File. A flag to indicate that there is a record in the disability and need supplemental file for this person that includes data on lock-in status.
content.splmtl_dsb_othr: String: Beneficiary Other Needs Record in Supplemental Disability File. A flag to indicate that there is record in the disability and need supplemental file for this person with monthly values of: HCBS chronic conditions, care level status for Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) program, disabilities (concentrating, walking, dressing/bathing, and errands), pregnancy, enrollment in Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI), receipt of Supplemental Security Income (SSI), SSI State supplement status, SSI status, Birth to Conception status, receipt of Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) benefits, had some form of third party liability (TPL) insurance coverage and/or had some other form of third party liability (TPL) funding besides insurance coverage.
content.da_run_id: String: TAF Production Run Identifier (unique for each TAF run). A unique identifier that identifies the TAF production run that produced the TAF file.
content.de_vrsn: String: DE Version Representing the Iteration of the File. Indicator representing the iteration of the file.
content.ccw_ld_dt: Date32[day]: CCW Load Date. The Date Source File was Loaded to the CCW
content.elgbl_aftr_eoy_ind: Int32: Eligible After End of Year - Indicator. Indicates if the beneficiary's T-MSIS eligibility end date was recoded to the last day of the calendar year because the original eligibility end date was either NULL or after the last day of the calendar year, either of which indicates the beneficiary was eligible beyond the calendar year.
content.filename_1: String: FILENAME_1. Secondary filename or duplicate provenance field. Not found in the TAF DE codebook; likely added during parquet export or ETL.
content.age: Int32: Age (in years). Beneficiary age in years during the last month of enrollment in the calendar year.
content.bene_zip_cd_norm: String: BENE_ZIP_CD_NORM. Normalized beneficiary ZIP code, likely a standardized/cleaned version of BENE_ZIP_CD created during data processing. Not found in the TAF DE codebook.
content.zcta: String: ZIP Code Tabulation Area. ZIP Code Tabulation Area: a U.S. Census Bureau geographic area created to allow mapping and geographic analysis of USPS ZIP Codes. Not found in the TAF DE codebook.
